_comment: Single source of truth for real external competitor agents used for
MEASUREMENT ONLY (#78, ADR-0008 amendment 2026-08-18). These are never
vendored into this repo -- scripts/fetch_external_agents.py reads this
file and downloads each entry into a gitignored local directory
(external_agents/ by default). No third-party code is committed to git.
Every entry's license was checked by the #67 survey before being added
here; do not add an entry without a confirmed permissive license.

agents.name: pilkwang_structured_economic_policy
agents.attribution: pilkwang, "Kaggriculture: Structured Economic Policy" (https://www.kaggle.com/code/pilkwang/kaggriculture-structured-economic-policy), Apache License 2.0.
agents.notes: Kaggle notebook; the submittable agent lives in the single code cell tagged with the `%%agentfile` cell magic (writes kaggle's main.py). The fetch script extracts that cell only -- the rest of the notebook is narrative/plotting for the writeup and is not fetched or executed.

agents.name: madhur_sabherwal_hub_geometry_agent
agents.notes: Structurally distinct job-scoring approach (hub geometry), picked for strategic diversity per the #67 survey.

agents.name: seyamalam_candidate_v6_adaptive_livestock
agents.notes: DO NOT fetch this author's candidate_v7_public_v18/v19/v20/v21 -- those are 300KB+ compressed-blob replayers, explicitly rejected by the #67 survey. Only v1-v6 (plain heuristic agents) are in scope, and only v6 is vendored here.

agents.name: alexandergremyakov_harvest_pulse_goose_dividend_v2
agents.notes: Kaggle notebook; single code cell tagged `%%writefile /kaggle/working/main.py`. The fetch script extracts that cell only.
